REPORT zcv_method_types_owner.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
         name TYPE c LENGTH 20,
       END OF ty_record.

CLASS lcl_repro DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export IMPORTING is_record TYPE ty_record.
    METHODS validate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_repro IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export.
    DATA ls_record TYPE ty_record.
    DATA lt_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    ls_record = is_record.
    APPEND ls_record TO lt_records.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_record.
    DATA ls_record TYPE ty_record.
    ls_record-status = 'X'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA go_repro TYPE REF TO lcl_repro.
  DATA gs_record TYPE ty_record.
  go_repro = NEW #( ).
  go_repro->export( gs_record ).
  go_repro->validate( ).
